name: loom-mentor
description: Use when a loom hint (a tool result's `hint`, an `X-Loom-Hint` header or a "Loom mentor" line) names a plane or op you do not know how to use, or when the user asks "what can loom do", "how should I be using loom", "am I using loom well", "loom mentor". A hint that already names the op to call needs no skill: call it or carry on with the task. Maps a situation to the loom plane and op that fits — code index, tracker record, documents, records, working memory, offload, the entity graph, runs, decisions, procedures, duplicates, conflicts, bisect — and says what to do about each hint code. NOT for deciding the shape of one write (loom-memory), NOT for grep-vs-code.* in an indexed repo (loom-code), NOT for reworking a namespace that already holds the wrong shape (loom-optimize).
